     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Stable context for finite-stage Picard gluing
    10	
    11	`Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData` fixes the chart and pair-transition models at one
    12	finite stage.  The triple-transition producer then needs a comparison family for those
    13	same models and produces a further finite stage.  This record keeps these dependent values
    14	together, so gluing consumers can pass one context instead of repeatedly rebuilding the
    15	comparison family and re-elaborating the nested tensor carriers.
    16	
    17	The fields are ordinary data fields: no `letI` binders occur in the public type and this
    18	file installs no global instances.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory TensorProduct
    26	open scoped TensorProduct
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	noncomputable section
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    35	
    36	/-- All finite-stage data needed by the affine Picard gluing construction.
    37	
    38	`models` fixes the common stages, presentations, maps, and pair-transition compatibilities.
    39	`Q` fixes the scalar-extension comparison for every cyclic triple.  `triple` stores the
    40	next finite stage of cyclic transitions together with its comparison squares.
    41	-/
    42	structure Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext
    43	    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k] where
    44	  models : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F
    45	  Q : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
    46	    k ⊗[models.M.1]
    47	        Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
    48	          C models.L models.n models.m models.relation models.M models.mapM q ≃ₐ[k]
    49	      Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2
    50	  triple : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData
    51	    C models.L models.n models.m models.relation models.M models.mapM Q
    52	
    53	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext
    54	
    55	variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    56	
    57	/-! ## Transparent projections -/
    58	
    59	def L (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.L
    60	def n (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.n
    61	def m (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.m
    62	def relation (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.relation
    63	def e (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.e
    64	def M (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.M
    65	def mapM (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.models.mapM
    66	def N (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.triple.N
    67	def thetaN (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F) := D.triple.thetaN
    68	
    69	/-! ## Stored compatibility certificates -/
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	theorem comparison
    73	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    74	    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
    75	    Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelComparison C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.e D.M D.mapM q :=
    76	  D.models.comparison q
    77	
    78	@[simp]
    79	theorem openImmersion
    80	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    81	    (i : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C) :
    82	    Pic0FiniteStageTransitionOpenImmersion C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM i :=
    83	  D.models.openImmersion i
    84	
    85	@[simp]
    86	theorem inverse
    87	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    88	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    89	    Pic0FiniteStageTransitionInverse C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM U V :=
    90	  D.models.inverse U V
    91	
    92	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
    93	-- The dependent triple family unfolds two tensor-model towers in this result type.
    94	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    95	@[simp]
    96	theorem tripleComparison
    97	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    98	    (p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C) :
    99	    Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyComparison
   100	      C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM D.Q D.triple.N p (D.triple.thetaN p) :=
   101	  D.triple.comparison p
   102	
   103	end Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext
   104	
   105	end
   106	
   107	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransitionFace
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Canonical finite-stage glue contexts
    11	
    12	The general glue context keeps an explicit comparison family because it is useful while
    13	assembling finite-stage data. A face consumer, however, needs the concrete comparison
    14	family attached to the selected transition models. This module provides that boundary
    15	without changing the legacy context: the family is fixed in the type of the triple data,
    16	so a separately reconstructed comparison cannot silently enter a downstream statement.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TensorProduct
    24	open scoped TensorProduct
    25	
    26	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    31	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    32	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    33	
    34	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext
    35	
    36	variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    37	
    38	/-! ## The canonical comparison family -/
    39	
    40	/- The family is kept behind an opaque witness so elaborating a context never unfolds the
    41	dependent tensor-model comparison.  The witness also stores the specification equation; this
    42	is the proof-level bridge needed by consumers that use the model-level face theorem.
    43	-/
    44	noncomputable opaque canonicalComparisonWitness
    45	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F) :
    46	    {Q : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
    47	      k ⊗[D.M.1] Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
    48	          C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM q ≃ₐ[k]
    49	        Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 //
    50	      Q = pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily C D.L D.n D.m D.relation
    51	        D.e D.M D.mapM D.comparison} :=
    52	  ⟨pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily C D.L D.n D.m D.relation
    53	      D.e D.M D.mapM D.comparison, rfl⟩
    54	
    55	/-- The comparison family determined by one bundled transition-model datum. -/
    56	noncomputable def canonicalComparisonFamily
    57	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F) :=
    58	  (canonicalComparisonWitness C D).1
    59	
    60	@[simp]
    61	theorem canonicalComparisonFamily_spec
    62	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F) :
    63	    canonicalComparisonFamily C D =
    64	      pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily C D.L D.n D.m D.relation
    65	        D.e D.M D.mapM D.comparison :=
    66	  (canonicalComparisonWitness C D).2
    67	
    68	/-! ## Canonical constructor -/
    69	
    70	/-- Build a legacy-compatible context with the comparison family pinned to `D`. -/
    71	def ofCanonical
    72	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
    73	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
    74	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM (canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
    75	    Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F :=
    76	  { models := D
    77	    Q := canonicalComparisonFamily C D
    78	    triple := T }
    79	
    80	@[simp]
    81	theorem ofCanonical_models
    82	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
    83	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
    84	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM (canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
    85	    (ofCanonical C D T).models = D :=
    86	  rfl
    87	
    88	@[simp]
    89	theorem ofCanonical_Q
    90	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
    91	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
    92	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM (canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
    93	    (ofCanonical C D T).Q = canonicalComparisonFamily C D :=
    94	  rfl
    95	
    96	@[simp]
    97	theorem ofCanonical_triple
    98	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
    99	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
   100	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM (canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
   101	    (ofCanonical C D T).triple = T :=
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	end Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext
   105	
   106	/-! ## Canonical contexts -/
   107	
   108	/-- A finite-stage glue context whose stored comparison family is the one determined by its
   109	transition models.
   110	
   111	The general `Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext` remains useful while assembling arbitrary descended
   112	data.  Face and gluing consumers should use this wrapper: `q_spec` prevents the triple-family
   113	certificate from being silently disconnected from the model comparison used by the face
   114	theorem.
   115	-/
   116	structure Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext
   117	    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k] where
   118	  context : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F
   119	  q_spec : context.Q =
   120	    Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily C context.models
   121	
   122	namespace Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext
   123	
   124	variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   125	
   126	/-- Retain a general context after supplying the missing canonicality invariant. -/
   127	def ofContext
   128	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
   129	    (hQ : D.Q = Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily C D.models) :
   130	    Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F :=
   131	  { context := D, q_spec := hQ }
   132	
   133	/-! The family and its dependent triple data are accepted together at this boundary.  In
   134	contrast to transporting a record with `hQ ▸ T`, this constructor preserves the selected
   135	family in the context and uses the equality only for the small canonicality field. -/
   136	def ofModelsWithComparison
   137	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
   138	    (Q : ∀ p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
   139	      k ⊗[D.M.1]
   140	          Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
   141	            C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM p ≃ₐ[k]
   142	        Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
   143	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData
   144	      C D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM Q)
   145	    (hQ : Q = Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily C D) :
   146	    Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F :=
   147	  { context := { models := D, Q := Q, triple := T }
   148	    q_spec := hQ }
   149	
   150	/-- Bundle model and triple data without forgetting that the triple family uses the canonical
   151	comparison attached to those models. -/
   152	def ofModels
   153	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
   154	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
   155	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM
   156	        (Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
   157	    Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F :=
   158	  { context := Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.ofCanonical C D T
   159	    q_spec := rfl }
   160	
   161	/-- Forget canonicality only when calling a legacy general-context API. -/
   162	def toGlueContext (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F) :
   163	    Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F :=
   164	  D.context
   165	
   166	/-- The transition models selected by a canonical context. -/
   167	def models (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F) :=
   168	  D.context.models
   169	
   170	/-- The triple-transition family selected by a canonical context. -/
   171	def triple (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F) :=
   172	  D.context.triple
   173	
   174	/-- The comparison family stored by the underlying general context. -/
   175	def Q (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F) :=
   176	  D.context.Q
   177	
   178	/-- The final finite scalar stage selected by a canonical context. -/
   179	def N (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F) :=
   180	  D.context.triple.N
   181	
   182	/-- The descended cyclic transition family at the final scalar stage. -/
   183	def thetaN (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F) :=
   184	  D.context.triple.thetaN
   185	
   186	@[simp]
   187	theorem ofModels_models
   188	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
   189	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
   190	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM
   191	        (Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
   192	    (ofModels C D T).models = D :=
   193	  rfl
   194	
   195	@[simp]
   196	theorem ofModels_triple
   197	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelsData C F)
   198	    (T : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyData C
   199	      D.L D.n D.m D.relation D.M D.mapM
   200	        (Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily C D)) :
   201	    (ofModels C D T).triple = T :=
   202	  rfl
   203	
   204	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   205	-- Normalizing the dependent family unfolds tensor models in both comparison directions.
   206	set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000 in
   207	/-- The stored triple-transition certificate, normalized to the concrete comparison family
   208	used by the model-level face theorem. -/
   209	theorem comparison
   210	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F)
   211	    (p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C) :
   212	    Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyComparison C
   213	      D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   214	      D.context.models.relation D.context.models.M D.context.models.mapM
   215	      (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily C
   216	        D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   217	        D.context.models.relation D.context.models.e D.context.models.M
   218	        D.context.models.mapM D.context.models.comparison)
   219	      D.context.triple.N p (D.context.triple.thetaN p) := by
   220	  rw [← Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext.canonicalComparisonFamily_spec C D.context.models,
   221	    ← D.q_spec]
   222	  exact D.context.triple.comparison p
   223	
   224	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   225	-- The explicit legacy square repeats the dependent source and target tensor carriers.
   226	set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000 in
   227	/-- The concrete comparison square expected by the legacy affine face proof, obtained from
   228	the canonical context rather than from a separately supplied certificate. -/
   229	theorem comparison_of_models
   230	    (D : Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext C F)
   231	    (p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C) :
   232	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map D.context.triple.N.1.val
   233	        (AlgHom.id D.context.models.M.1
   234	          (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget C
   235	            D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   236	            D.context.models.relation D.context.models.M D.context.models.mapM p))).comp
   237	        ((D.context.triple.thetaN p).restrictScalars D.context.models.M.1) =
   238	      ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransitionOfModels C
   239	        D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   240	        D.context.models.relation D.context.models.e D.context.models.M
   241	        D.context.models.mapM D.context.models.comparison
   242	        p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2).restrictScalars D.context.models.M.1).comp
   243	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map D.context.triple.N.1.val
   244	          (AlgHom.id D.context.models.M.1
   245	            (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelSource C
   246	              D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   247	              D.context.models.relation D.context.models.M D.context.models.mapM p))) := by
   248	  change Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyComparison C
   249	    D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   250	    D.context.models.relation D.context.models.M D.context.models.mapM
   251	    (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily C
   252	      D.context.models.L D.context.models.n D.context.models.m
   253	      D.context.models.relation D.context.models.e D.context.models.M
   254	      D.context.models.mapM D.context.models.comparison)
   255	    D.context.triple.N p (D.context.triple.thetaN p)
   256	  exact D.comparison C p
   257	
   258	end Pic0FiniteStageCanonicalGlueContext

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRings
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.RepresenterData

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal Picard class on the finite affine atlas
    11	
    12	The separably closed Picard representer carries one canonical universal class, obtained
    13	from its `RepresentableBy` equivalence at the identity.  This file restricts that same
    14	class to every chart and pairwise overlap in the chosen finite affine atlas and records
    15	the two restriction equations.  Thus later finite-subextension descent starts from one
    16	pinned universal element rather than independently chosen local classes.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	/-- The separably closed representer kept as a named package.
    34	
    35	The legacy API returns a dependent sigma; this projection is the migration boundary used by
    36	the universal-class declarations below.  The package does not select a new representer. -/
    37	noncomputable def pic0SepClosedRepresenterData :
    38	    AlgebraicJacobian.RepresenterData
    39	      (Over (Spec (.of k))) (pic0TypeFunctor C) :=
    40	  AlgebraicJacobian.RepresenterData.ofSigma
    41	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C))
    42	
    43	/-- The universal degree-zero Picard class pinned by the separably closed
    44	`RepresentableBy` certificate. -/
    45	noncomputable def pic0SepClosedUniversalClass :
    46	    pic0Subgroup C (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=
    47	  (pic0SepClosedRepresenterData C).representation.homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    48	
    49	/-- The restriction of the pinned universal class to one affine chart. -/
    50	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass
    51	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    52	    pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)) :=
    53	  (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    54	    (Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 U.1)
    55	
    56	/-- The restriction of the pinned universal class to one affine pairwise overlap. -/
    57	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass
    58	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    59	    pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)) :=
    60	  (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    61	    (Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    62	      (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V))
    63	
    64	private theorem pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft_eq_resAlgHom
    65	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    66	    pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V =
    67	      Over.resAlgHom (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    68	        (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U V) := by
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	private theorem pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight_eq_resAlgHom
    72	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    73	    pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V =
    74	      Over.resAlgHom (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    75	        (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V) := by
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	/-- The universal chart class restricts to the universal overlap class along the left
    79	atlas leg. -/
    80	theorem pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass_restrict_left
    81	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    82	    pic0Map C (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V))
    83	        (pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass C U) =
    84	      pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass C U V := by
    85	  rw [pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass, pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass]
    86	  calc
    87	    _ = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    88	        (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V) ≫
    89	          Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 U.1) := by
    90	      change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
    91	        (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V)).op
    92	          ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    93	            (Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 U.1)) = _
    94	      exact ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv_comp
    95	        (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V))
    96	        (Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 U.1)).symm
    97	    _ = _ := by
    98	      apply congrArg (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    99	      rw [pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft_eq_resAlgHom]
   100	      exact Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom
   101	        (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U V)
   102	
   103	/-- The universal chart class restricts to the universal overlap class along the right
   104	atlas leg. -/
   105	theorem pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass_restrict_right
   106	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   107	    pic0Map C (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V))
   108	        (pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass C V) =
   109	      pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass C U V := by
   110	  rw [pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass, pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass]
   111	  calc
   112	    _ = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
   113	        (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V) ≫
   114	          Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 V.1) := by
   115	      change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   116	        (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V)).op
   117	          ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
   118	            (Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 V.1)) = _
   119	      exact ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv_comp
   120	        (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V))
   121	        (Over.fromSpecAffine (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 V.1)).symm
   122	    _ = _ := by
   123	      apply congrArg (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
   124	      rw [pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight_eq_resAlgHom]
   125	      exact Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom
   126	        (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V)
   127	
   128	/-- The finite atlas carries restrictions of one pinned universal Picard class, with both
   129	overlap equations retained as data for finite-stage descent. -/
   130	structure Pic0FiniteStageUniversalAtlasClass where
   131	  universal : pic0Subgroup C (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   132	  chart : forall U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C,
   133	    pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U))
   134	  overlap : forall U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C,
   135	    pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V))
   136	  chart_eq : forall U, chart U = pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass C U
   137	  overlap_eq : forall U V, overlap U V = pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass C U V
   138	  restrict_left : forall U V,
   139	    pic0Map C (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V)) (chart U) =
   140	      overlap U V
   141	  restrict_right : forall U V,
   142	    pic0Map C (Over.overSpecMap (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V)) (chart V) =
   143	      overlap U V
   144	
   145	/-- The canonical universal-class package on the chosen finite atlas. -/
   146	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageUniversalAtlasClass :
   147	    Pic0FiniteStageUniversalAtlasClass C where
   148	  universal := pic0SepClosedUniversalClass C
   149	  chart := pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass C
   150	  overlap := pic0FiniteStageUniversalOverlapClass C
   151	  chart_eq := fun _ => rfl
   152	  overlap_eq := fun _ _ => rfl
   153	  restrict_left := pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass_restrict_left C
   154	  restrict_right := pic0FiniteStageUniversalChartClass_restrict_right C
   155	
   156	end
   157	
   158	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# The Yoneda map attached to a Picard-zero class
    10	
    11	An element of the degree-zero Picard functor on a test object determines its
    12	Yoneda family by pullback.  This is the small binder-free bridge used by the
    13	finite-stage descent lane.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Opposite
    21	
    22	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    23	
    24	noncomputable section
    25	
    26	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    27	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    28	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    29	
    30	/-! ## The class-to-Yoneda construction -/
    31	
    32	/-- The Yoneda family induced by a degree-zero Picard class on `J`. -/
    33	noncomputable def pic0ClassYoneda {J : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	    (u : pic0Subgroup C J) : yoneda.obj J ⟶ pic0TypeFunctor C :=
    35	  yonedaEquiv.symm u
    36	
    37	@[simp]
    38	theorem pic0ClassYoneda_app {J : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    39	    (u : pic0Subgroup C J) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T ⟶ J) :
    40	    (pic0ClassYoneda C u).app (op T) f = pic0Map C f u := by
    41	  calc
    42	    (pic0ClassYoneda C u).app (op T) f =
    43	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map f.op u := by
    44	      simpa [pic0ClassYoneda] using
    45	        (yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) u (op T) f)
    46	    _ = pic0Map C f u := by
    47	      exact pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply (C := C) f.op u
    48	
    49	/-! ## The pinned separably closed universal class -/
    50	
    51	variable [IsSepClosed k]
    52	
    53	/-- The Yoneda family attached to the pinned separably closed universal class. -/
    54	noncomputable def pic0SepClosedClassYoneda :
    55	    yoneda.obj (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 ⟶ pic0TypeFunctor C :=
    56	  pic0ClassYoneda C (pic0SepClosedUniversalClass C)
    57	
    58	@[simp]
    59	theorem pic0SepClosedClassYoneda_app {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    60	    (f : T ⟶ (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1) :
    61	    (pic0SepClosedClassYoneda C).app (op T) f =
    62	      (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv f := by
    63	  rw [pic0SepClosedClassYoneda, pic0ClassYoneda_app,
    64	    pic0SepClosedUniversalClass]
    65	  calc
    66	    (pic0Map C f)
    67	        ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    68	          (𝟙 (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1)) =
    69	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map f.op
    70	          ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    71	            (𝟙 (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1)) := by
    72	      exact (pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply (C := C) f.op _).symm
    73	    _ = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv
    74	          (f ≫ 𝟙 (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1) := by
    75	      exact ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv_comp
    76	        f (𝟙 (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1)).symm
    77	    _ = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2.homEquiv f := by
    78	      rw [Category.comp_id]
    79	
    80	end
    81	
    82	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# A finitely presented Picard representative preserves filtered base colimits
    11	
    12	Representability turns the fixed-base Picard-zero functor into the functor of morphisms to its
    13	representing scheme.  If that scheme is locally of finite presentation, the scheme-theoretic
    14	finite-stage factorization and equality theorems show that this functor preserves the filtered
    15	colimits occurring in `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	/-- A locally finitely presented scheme representing `pic0TypeFunctor C` discharges the
    27	fixed-base filtered-colimit residual `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C`. -/
    28	theorem pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit_of_representableBy
    29	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    32	    (J : Over (Spec (.of k))) (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    33	    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation J.hom] :
    34	    Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C := by
    35	  intro I _ _ S h_aff hcompact hqs _
    36	  letI : IsConnected I := IsCofiltered.isConnected I
    37	  let D := S ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of k))
    38	  let t : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (Spec (.of k)) :=
    39	    { app := fun i => (S.obj i).hom
    40	      naturality := fun {i j} f => by
    41	        change (S.map f).left ≫ (S.obj j).hom = (S.obj i).hom ≫ 𝟙 _
    42	        rw [Category.comp_id]
    43	        exact Over.w (S.map f) }
    44	  let c : Cone D := (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapCone (limit.cone S)
    45	  have hc : IsLimit c :=
    46	    isLimitOfPreserves (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))) (limit.isLimit S)
    47	  letI {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j) : IsAffineHom (D.map f) := h_aff f
    48	  letI (i : I) : CompactSpace (D.obj i) := hcompact i
    49	  letI (i : I) : QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i) := hqs i
    50	  refine preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone
    51	    (K := S.op) (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) (limit.isLimit S).op ?_
    52	  refine Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' (S.op ⋙ pic0TypeFunctor C)
    53	    ((pic0TypeFunctor C).mapCocone (limit.cone S).op) ?_ ?_
    54	  · intro x
    55	    let a : limit S ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm x
    56	    have ha : c.π ≫ t = (Functor.const I).map (a.left ≫ J.hom) := by
    57	      ext i
    58	      change (limit.π S i).left ≫ (S.obj i).hom = a.left ≫ J.hom
    59	      rw [Over.w (limit.π S i), Over.w a]
    60	    obtain ⟨i, g, hg, hgbase⟩ :=
    61	      Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation
    62	        D t J.hom c hc a.left ha
    63	    let g' : S.obj i ⟶ J := Over.homMk g hgbase
    64	    refine ⟨op i, rep.homEquiv g', ?_⟩
    65	    change x = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (limit.π S i).op (rep.homEquiv g')
    66	    rw [← rep.homEquiv_comp]
    67	    rw [show x = rep.homEquiv a from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply x).symm]
    68	    apply congrArg rep.homEquiv
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact hg.symm
    71	  · intro ii x y hxy
    72	    let i := unop ii
    73	    let a : S.obj i ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm x
    74	    let b : S.obj i ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm y
    75	    have ha : t.app i = a.left ≫ J.hom := (Over.w a).symm
    76	    have hb : t.app i = b.left ≫ J.hom := (Over.w b).symm
    77	    have habOver : limit.π S i ≫ a = limit.π S i ≫ b := by
    78	      apply rep.homEquiv.injective
    79	      rw [rep.homEquiv_comp, rep.homEquiv_comp,
    80	        rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply, rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    81	      exact hxy
    82	    have hab : c.π.app i ≫ a.left = c.π.app i ≫ b.left :=
    83	      congrArg Over.Hom.left habOver
    84	    obtain ⟨j, hji, heq⟩ :=
    85	      Scheme.exists_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    86	        D t J.hom c hc a.left b.left ha hb hab
    87	    refine ⟨op j, hji.op, ?_⟩
    88	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (S.map hji).op x =
    89	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (S.map hji).op y
    90	    rw [show x = rep.homEquiv a from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply x).symm,
    91	      show y = rep.homEquiv b from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply y).symm,
    92	      ← rep.homEquiv_comp, ← rep.homEquiv_comp]
    93	    apply congrArg rep.homEquiv
    94	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    95	    exact heq
    96	
    97	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Transporting a Picard-zero representative through a field extension
    12	
    13	The base-change comparison `pic0ThetaType` and the adjunction
    14	`Over.mapPullbackAdj` transport a genuine `RepresentableBy` certificate to a
    15	base-changed curve.  The representing object is still only determined up to
    16	isomorphism, so the final object isomorphism is an explicit input.  Keeping
    17	that input visible prevents this lemma from silently asserting either finite
    18	stage descent or compatibility between independently named curves.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe v v₁ u₁ u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy
    28	
    29	/-! ## Object-isomorphism transport -/
    30	
    31	/-- Move a representation along an isomorphism of representing objects. -/
    32	noncomputable def ofObjectIso
    33	    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}
    34	    {X Y : C} (r : F.RepresentableBy X) (e : X ≅ Y) :
    35	    F.RepresentableBy Y where
    36	  homEquiv := fun {Z} =>
    37	    { toFun := fun f => r.homEquiv (f ≫ e.inv)
    38	      invFun := fun x => r.homEquiv.symm x ≫ e.hom
    39	      left_inv := by
    40	        intro f
    41	        dsimp
    42	        rw [r.homEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Category.assoc,
    43	          Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    44	      right_inv := by
    45	        intro x
    46	        dsimp
    47	        rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id,
    48	          r.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply] }
    49	  homEquiv_comp := by
    50	    intro Z Z' f g
    51	    dsimp
    52	    rw [Category.assoc, r.homEquiv_comp]
    53	
    54	end CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy
    55	
    56	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    57	
    58	noncomputable section
    59	
    60	variable {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    61	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    62	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    63	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    64	
    65	/-! ## Picard-zero transport -/
    66	
    67	/-- Transport a genuine Picard-zero representing object across `k → L`.
    68	
    69	The first step is the right-adjoint transport along
    70	`Over.mapPullbackAdj`; `pic0ThetaType.symm` then identifies the resulting
    71	presheaf with the degree-zero Picard functor of the base-changed curve.  The
    72	explicit `e` is the only object-level input needed to select the requested
    73	representing object.
    74	-/
    75	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_of_baseChangeObjectIso
    76	    {J : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    77	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    78	    {J' : Over (Spec (.of L))}
    79	    (e :
    80	      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj J ≅ J') :
    81	    (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange k L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J' := by
    82	  let pulled :=
    83	    CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.ofLeftAdjoint
    84	      (Over.mapPullbackAdj (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))) rep
    85	  let rebased := pulled.ofIso (pic0ThetaType k L C).symm
    86	  exact CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.ofObjectIso rebased e
    87	
    88	end
    89	
    90	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# The finite-stage comparison in the slice category
    11	
    12	The global glued comparison is compatible with the structure maps, so it is an
    13	isomorphism in `Over (Spec k)`.  Consequently the scalar extension of the
    14	finite-stage glued object represents Picard-zero over the separably closed field.
    15	
    16	This is deliberately a post-base-change statement.  It does not assert that
    17	the finite-stage object already represents Picard-zero over its field of definition;
    18	that requires descent of the universal class and its Yoneda equivalence.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    32	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    33	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    34

    11	/-!
    12	# Jacobian data from conditional finite Galois descent
    13	
    14	The finite Galois quotient representing Picard zero inherits local finite type
    15	and quasi-compactness from the chosen representer after scalar extension.  This
    16	packages the existing conditional representability theorem into the exact
    17	`PicRepDatum` and `JacobianData` interfaces, without hiding either the local
    18	representer or the orbit-in-an-affine-open hypothesis.
    19	
    20	The finite-stage specializations below import the orbit-affineness producer directly. They
    21	remain conditional on the displayed projectivity witness; this module does not assert the
    22	missing arbitrary-field `pic0_representableBy` theorem.
    23	-/

    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    30	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    34	noncomputable section
    35	
    36	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    37	
    38	/-- Local finite type of a Picard-zero representer descends through the glued
    39	finite Galois quotient. -/
    40	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_pic0FiniteGaloisDescent
    41	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    42	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    45	    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
    46	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
    47	    (hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom)
    48	    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
    49	    LocallyOfFiniteType
    50	      (StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientMap
    51	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) := by
    52	  letI := hlft
    53	  exact IsGaloisQuotient.locallyOfFiniteType
    54	    (StableAffineOpen.isGaloisQuotient_glued
    55	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep))
    56	
    57	/-- Quasi-compactness of a Picard-zero representer descends through the glued
    58	finite Galois quotient. -/
    59	theorem quasiCompact_pic0FiniteGaloisDescent
    60	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    61	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    62	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    63	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    64	    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
    65	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
    66	    (hqc : QuasiCompact J.hom)
    67	    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
    68	    QuasiCompact
    69	      (StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientMap
    70	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) := by
    71	  letI := hqc
    72	  exact IsGaloisQuotient.quasiCompact
    73	    (StableAffineOpen.isGaloisQuotient_glued
    74	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep))
    75	
    76	/-- The conditional finite Galois quotient, packaged as representability data
    77	over the original field. -/
    78	noncomputable def picRepDatum_finiteGaloisDescent
    79	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    80	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    81	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    82	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    83	    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
    84	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
    85	    (hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom)
    86	    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
    87	    PicRepDatum K K C where
    88	  J := StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
    89	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)
    90	  rep := pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent C rep
    91	  lft := locallyOfFiniteType_pic0FiniteGaloisDescent C rep hlft
    92	
    93	/-- The same conditional quotient, packaged in the challenge-facing
    94	`JacobianData` interface without changing its carrier or representation. -/
    95	noncomputable def jacobianData_finiteGaloisDescent
    96	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    97	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    98	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    99	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
   100	    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
   101	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
   102	    (hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom) (hqc : QuasiCompact J.hom)
   103	    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
   104	    JacobianData C :=
   105	  (picRepDatum_finiteGaloisDescent C rep hlft).toJacobianData
   106	    (quasiCompact_pic0FiniteGaloisDescent C rep hqc)

   108	/-! ## Finite-stage projective specialization -/
   109	
   110	variable {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F]
   111	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   112	
   113	/-- Finite-stage projectivity packages the conditional finite Galois descent as a
   114	`PicRepDatum` over the original field.
   115	
   116	This is still a conditional producer: the projectivity of the finite-stage glued carrier is
   117	the visible geometric input which supplies orbit-affineness for the canonical semilinear
   118	action. -/
   119	noncomputable def picRepDatum_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isProjective
   120	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   121	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   122	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   123	    (Ck : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   124	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
   125	    [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
   126	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageStableGluePackage Ck F)
   127	    [Algebra K P.context.triple.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.context.triple.N.1]
   128	    [IsGalois K P.context.triple.N.1]
   129	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.context.triple.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy
   130	      P.presentation.over)
   131	    (hproj : P.presentation.map.IsProjective) :
   132	    PicRepDatum K K C := by
   133	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
   134	    pic0FiniteStageStableOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
   135	  exact
   136	    { J := StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
   137	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)
   138	      rep := pic0RepresentableBy_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
   139	      lft :=
   140	        locallyOfFiniteType_pic0FiniteGaloisDescent C rep
   141	          (by
   142	            change LocallyOfFiniteType P.presentation.map
   143	            exact hproj.locallyOfFiniteType) }
   144	
   145	/-- Finite-stage projectivity packages the conditional finite Galois descent directly as
   146	`JacobianData`.  The finite-stage glued carrier is already locally of finite type and
   147	quasi-compact; projectivity is only used to discharge the orbit-affineness input to the
   148	Galois quotient. -/
   149	noncomputable def jacobianData_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isProjective
   150	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   151	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   152	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   153	    (Ck : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   154	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
   155	    [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
   156	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageStableGluePackage Ck F)
   157	    [Algebra K P.context.triple.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.context.triple.N.1]
   158	    [IsGalois K P.context.triple.N.1]
   159	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.context.triple.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy
   160	      P.presentation.over)
   161	    (hproj : P.presentation.map.IsProjective) :
   162	    JacobianData C :=
   163	  (picRepDatum_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj).toJacobianData
   164	    (by
   165	      letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
   166	        pic0FiniteStageStableOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
   167	      exact quasiCompact_pic0FiniteGaloisDescent C rep
   168	        (by
   169	          change QuasiCompact P.presentation.map
   170	          letI : IsProper P.presentation.map := hproj.isProper
   171	          infer_instance))
   172	
   173	end
   174	
   175	end AlgebraicGeometry

    14	package its exact representation here without creating the import cycle through
    15	`RiemannRoch.ChiCurve` and `Challenge`.

    17	The only additional datum is quasi-compactness.  The representing object, universal
    18	equivalence, locally-finite-type certificate, and induced group object are carried across
    19	definitionally.

    36	/-- A representation datum at the challenge field, together with quasi-compactness of its
    37	representing object, is the pinned `JacobianData`.  All shared fields are definitionally

    57	@[simp]
    58	lemma toJacobianData_grpObj (d : PicRepDatum k k C) (hqc : QuasiCompact d.J.hom) :
    59	    (d.toJacobianData hqc).grpObj = d.grpObj :=

   293	
   294	/-- A family of representable open immersions covers pointwise as soon as it covers the class at
   295	every residue-field point.  Relative representability pulls a chosen field factorization back to
   296	an open immersion over the test; its open range is the required neighborhood. -/
   297	theorem pointwiseCoverage_of_residueField
   298	    {I : Type u} {X : I → Scheme.{u}}
   299	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   300	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
   301	    (hfield : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op T)) (t : T),
   302	      ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y) (y : Y ⟶ T) (i : I) (x : Y ⟶ X i),
   303	        y.base q = t ∧
   304	          (f i).app (op Y) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map y.op s) :
   305	    PointwiseCoverage C f := by
   306	  intro T s t
   307	  obtain ⟨Y, q, y, i, x, hyt, hx⟩ := hfield T s t
   308	  let g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 := yonedaEquiv.symm s
   309	  obtain ⟨Z, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := (hf i).rep g
   310	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd := (hf i).property g fst snd hpb
   311	  have hpbY := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op Y)
   312	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbY
   313	  have hg : g.app (op Y) y = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map y.op s := by
   314	    exact yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply s _ y
   315	  obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := hpbY.2.2 x y (hx.trans hg.symm)
   316	  let W : T.Opens := snd.opensRange
   317	  have htW : t ∈ W := by
   318	    change t ∈ snd.opensRange
   319	    apply Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr
   320	    refine ⟨z.base q, ?_⟩
   321	    have hz := congrArg (fun m : Y ⟶ T => m.base q) hz₂
   322	    exact hz.trans hyt
   323	  refine ⟨W, htW, i, fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv, ?_⟩
   324	  have hpbW := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   325	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbW
   326	  have hcomm := congrArg
   327	    (fun q => (ConcreteCategory.hom q) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) hpbW.1
   328	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   329	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) = _
   330	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   331	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) =
   332	    g.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (snd.isoOpensRange.inv ≫ snd) at hcomm
   333	  rw [Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_inv_comp] at hcomm
   334	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   335	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) =
   336	    (yonedaEquiv.symm s).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) W.ι at hcomm
   337	  rwa [yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply] at hcomm

   343	/-- Every degree-zero field class is hit by the translated chart indexed by the exact base class
   344	returned by `exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen`. -/
   345	theorem exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization
   346	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C))
   347	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   348	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
   349	    ∃ (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C))
   350	      (x : (overSpec k K).left ⟶
   351	        (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C)
   352	          (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen)).left),
   353	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   354	          (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a).app
   355	        (op (overSpec k K).left) x =
   356	          (⟨(overSpec k K).hom, mu⟩ :
   357	            (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (overSpec k K).left)) := by
   358	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hdeg, hsupp, hmem⟩ :=
   359	    exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen
   360	      (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) mu
   361	  letI := hLfield
   362	  letI := hkL
   363	  letI := hKL
   364	  letI := htow
   365	  letI := hfin
   366	  letI := hsep
   367	  let a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) :=
   368	    ⟨chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z, hdeg⟩
   369	  let baseValue : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (overSpec k K).left) :=
   370	    ⟨(overSpec k K).hom, mu⟩
   371	  let translatedValue :=
   372	    (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).hom.app
   373	      (op (overSpec k K).left) baseValue
   374	  have htranslated : translatedValue.2 = r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d := by
   375	    apply Subtype.ext
   376	    change mu.1 * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K) = _
   377	    rw [SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe]
   378	  have htranslatedMem : translatedValue.2 ∈
   379	      (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
   380	    rw [htranslated]
   381	    exact hmem
   382	  let v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
   383	      (op (overSpec k K).left) :=
   384	    ⟨translatedValue.1, ⟨translatedValue.2, htranslatedMem⟩⟩
   385	  let e := picRankOneOpenSigmaIso (C := C)
   386	    (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen)
   387	  refine ⟨a, e.inv.app (op (overSpec k K).left) v, ?_⟩
   388	  change (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv.app _
   389	      ((picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl (divRepAffP1Map C)).app _
   390	        (e.hom.app _ (e.inv.app _ v))) = baseValue
   391	  rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   392	  change (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv.app _
   393	      translatedValue = baseValue
   394	  exact (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).hom_inv_id_app_apply
   395	    _ baseValue

   398	
   399	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   400	-- Elaborating the residue-field specialization crosses both sigma-extension dependent fibres.
   401	/-- The translated rank-one charts cover the sigma extension pointwise.  At a point `t`,
   402	restrict the degree-zero class to `Spec κ(t)`, use the exact separably-closed translated
   403	rank-one factorization there, and take the whole residue-field point as the covering source. -/
   404	theorem picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage
   405	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   406	    PointwiseCoverage C (fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   407	      picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   408	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a) := by
   409	  apply pointwiseCoverage_of_residueField (C := C)
   410	  · exact fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   411	  · intro T s t
   412	    rcases s with ⟨b, mu⟩
   413	    let Tbar : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk b
   414	    let K := Over.testPointField (T := Tbar) t
   415	    let p : overSpec k K ⟶ Tbar := Over.testPoint (T := Tbar) t
   416	    let muK : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K) := (pic0TypeFunctor C).map p.op mu
   417	    obtain ⟨a, x, hx⟩ :=
   418	      exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization (C := C) hopen muK
   419	    let q : (overSpec k K).left := Classical.choice inferInstance
   420	    have hq : p.left.base q = t := by
   421	      dsimp only [p]
   422	      exact Over.testPoint_base (T := Tbar) t q
   423	    refine ⟨(overSpec k K).left, q, p.left, a, x, ?_, ?_⟩
   424	    · exact hq
   425	    · exact hx.trans (Over.sigmaExtension_map_left_mk p mu).symm
   426	
   427	/-- Over a separably closed field, openness of the rank-one Picard locus gives a scheme
   428	representing `Pic^0`.  This conditional form keeps the geometric gluing argument reusable. -/
   429	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   430	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   431	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   432	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   433	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   434	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   435	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   436	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   437	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   438	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C f
   439	    (fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a)⟩
   440	
   441	/-- Over a separably closed field, `Pic^0` is represented by the scheme obtained by gluing the
   442	translated canonical rank-one Abel charts. -/
   443	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   444	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J :=
   445	  pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   446	    (C := C) (picRankOneOpen_isOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C))
   447	
   448	/-- The exact separably closed representing scheme constructed above is locally of finite type
   449	over the base field. -/
   450	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   451	    LocallyOfFiniteType (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom := by
   452	  let hopen := picRankOneOpen_isOpen (C := C)
   453	    (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   454	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   455	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   456	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   457	  let hf := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   458	    picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   459	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   460	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   461	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   462	  change LocallyOfFiniteType (gluedHom C f hf)
   463	  apply locallyOfFiniteType_gluedHom C f hf
   464	  intro a
   465	  rw [chartHom_picRankOneTranslatedChart]
   466	  exact locallyOfFiniteType_divRankOneOpenOver h

    38	/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
    39	theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    40	    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    41	    Function.Surjective f.base := by
    42	  intro y
    43	  let s : ToType ((yoneda.obj Y).obj (op (Spec (Y.residueField y)))) :=
    44	    Y.fromSpecResidueField y
    45	  have hmem := h.imageSieve_mem s
    46	  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    47	    (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hmem
    48	  obtain ⟨r⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
    49	  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := cover.exists_eq r
    50	  have hi : (Presieve.ofArrows cover.X cover.f) (cover.f i) := ⟨i⟩
    51	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) hi
    52	  change q ≫ f = cover.f i ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y at hq
    53	  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
    54	  have hqz := congrArg (fun g : cover.X i ⟶ Y => g.base z) hq
    55	  change f.base (q.base z) = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base ((cover.f i).base z) at hqz
